plan.title: Reverse auction revoke unavailable after closure

steps.note: Start a single-stage auction creation flow.
a priced single-stage event needs its type set before a template (the screen opens as RFP)
Apply the first available auction template.
Add one product to the auction.
Commit a bidding schedule so the event can be published and later closed.
Invite the QA vendor who will act as Vendor A.
Verify the event reached a published project page.
Move to the separate supplier-portal session for Vendor A.
Open the published reverse auction's pricing round from the vendor event list.
Verify the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer session to close the event.
Wait for the reverse-auction bidding window to end naturally.
Inspect the closed event again in Vendor A's supplier session.
Reopen the closed reverse auction's pricing round.
Verify Vendor A's bid remains submitted after closure.
Check that no Revoke control is visible after bidding ends.
